title: Task State
description: Orchestrator-maintained state for a task. Written to .tmp/<task-id>/state.json. Tracks sub-task progress and conflict resolutions.

task_id.description: ClickUp task ID or session ID (e.g. RTD-541, session-1717500000)

adr_approved_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of ADR approval. Set before Developer is invoked.

branch.description: Git branch for this sub-task (e.g. agent/RTD-541/fr1)

pr_url.description: Pull request URL once Developer creates the PR

review_verdict.description: Architect progress-review verdict for this sub-task

reviewed_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of last Architect review

figma_conflict_resolution.description: Human decision when Figma and ADR conflict. See rules/figma-conflict.md.

blockers.description: List of blocker descriptions when status is blocked
